interpretation: Observed offsets rebase to96-current phase on an actual division change. Waveform experiments distinguish retaining the new division previous phase under the old offset from resetting it or adding an unconditional trigger. Only old-phase/new-offset passes all12 discovery programs. This previous-phase rule is inferred from the scalar and full-output evidence; the observer did not directly read the per-division previous-phase field. Equal position writes rearm a released strip but do not reset a held roll.
scope: Development identification, followed by12 separately frozen moving-strip programs and an89-program independent audit. No original instructions/audio are distributed.
